justification: The clearest overlap is only general: both use schematic outline carving with ovals/circles, repeated short strokes, and some horizontal banding or register-like organization. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by a single frontal anthropomorphic body/figure with facial and torso features, while B is a panel of separate signs and animal-like/profile figures arranged in registers, with no comparable central human-body scheme.
